heltec-v3.notes: Standard TimingPod V2 (RFID + Lidar pods, TOFSense-F2 Mini). 2.9.1 shows the identified bib number full screen on the OLED for 3 s on every beam break, at the same instant as the beep.

timingpod-v2demo.notes: Demo pods with Benewake TFmini-S IIC LiDAR (5V). 2.9.1 shows the identified bib number full screen on the OLED for 3 s on every beam break, at the same instant as the beep.

heltec-v3-gateway.notes: RaceVillage gateway. Rebuilt at 2.9.1 for version parity with the pods; the bib display is a pod-side feature and does not apply to the gateway.

beacon-esp32c3.notes: Source-only: beacons are built per-bib by the Device Manager. 3.1.0 adds the RACE DAY 8-hour hold and the advertisement frame the desktop's Beacons tab reads.
